purpose: Centralized path constants and registry key names for the app's data directory, config file, tray icon, and startup registry entry.
invariants: CurrentExePath falls back to AppContext.BaseDirectory if ProcessPath is blank
gotchas: LegacyInstalledExePath exists only to migrate old startup registry entries pointing at the old self-installed copy in %APPDATA%; do not use it for any other purpose
CurrentExePath is a computed property (not readonly) so it re-evaluates on each access
